status: PLANNED; all modeling/rigging/baking gates NOT RUN
scope: Production order and evidence contract only, not a completed Mia model.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Freeze approved concept-reference paths/SHA and all three Pixal candidate paths/SHA/structure. Pixal base and technique selection remain UNDECIDED until visual review.
acceptance_criteria.user_visible_outcome: Original art remains the priority while earlier Pixal results remain recoverable comparison/reuse choices.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Compare path/SHA with inventory.json; verify no approval baseline is claimed.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: inventory.json concept references, candidates, and interpretation limits.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Separate professional-pipeline sources, Neogools observed ASR/screen samples, and unobserved claims; do not publish full ASR or claim paid video viewing.
acceptance_criteria.user_visible_outcome: The plan uses evidence without overstating source access or mistaking a concrete modeling technique for a whole studio pipeline.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Review source access level and timestamps in README and linked Neogools record.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Use an iterative professional flow: brief → whole-character blockout/design alignment → production modeling/topology → stable-topology UV/lookdev with rig/weights as needed → rig stress and feedback → limited secondary plus common idle/30fps sprites. In Stage 1, face/body then hair attachment/volumes, garments, and bag/accessories are separately checked before production retopo/trial rig.
acceptance_criteria.user_visible_outcome: No single textured proxy is mistaken for a production-ready animation character, while good prior art/Pixal evidence may be reused where useful.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Every gate records near/far front/side/back/both-3/4 checks in clay/wire/actual-color as applicable; failures return to the responsible owner stage and are rechecked in the same views.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Define owners for head, eyes, lashes, scalp, front/rear/half-up/braid hair, body, crop, inner band, cardigan, pants, bag, strap, and hardware. Shared atlases are allowed; automatic Loose Parts must not be assumed semantic separation.
acceptance_criteria.user_visible_outcome: Hair, face, clothing, and bag can be replaced or diagnosed without treating a generated mesh as pre-separated.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Require an explicit owner table and per-part handoff before retopo/rig work.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Use low-cost early blink/gaze/jaw, hero-pose, head, arm/torso, sit, and step deformation tests; then perform production rig stress/model-weight-corrective feedback. Every shape check covers near/far front/side/back/both-3/4 in clay/wire/actual-color. Per-part bake uses cage/masks and original-albedo-led toon/lookdev so fixed PBR light/AO does not hide missing volume. Keep head/expression independent of replaceable hair; use limited collision proxies, reproducible pre-roll/cache/bake, loop seams/transitions, and 30fps sprite output checks.
acceptance_criteria.user_visible_outcome: Animation, replacements, and toon shading are validated before expensive finalization without making an unsupported claim that full rigging must precede UV.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Record pose library/on-model reference, multi-view captures, per-part bake outputs, cache/bake settings, and idle/event seam tests.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Preserve v01/v02 diagnostic workspaces as unapproved research and preserve existing 42-key/UV/body originals. Do not assume automatic transfer to new topology; state that the complete Mia model and further model changes remain unfinished.
acceptance_criteria.user_visible_outcome: Prior diagnostics stay inspectable while a future clean pipeline avoids destructive overwrite.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Source hashes/fingerprints and workspace status remain recorded; no model mutation is included in this milestone.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: mia-reference-modeling-v01/v02 reports and this workflow README.
